text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 429/5xx spike detected for org=zenbridge (org_id=zbridge-42). Error rate crossed threshold (>= 8%) across API gateways. Paging oncall. https://internal.incidents/1768884321

maria (oncall): oncall here, taking this. paging runtime + acct-eng. assigning incident owner.

dmitri (runtime): digging in — traffic for zenbridge jumped from ~80r/s -> ~920r/s in 3m. 429s are coming from rl throttle + some downstream 503s. p95 latency up ~2x. no active model deploys in the last hour.

kevin (sre-lead): thanks. sounds like a customer burst/replay. recommended mitigation: temporary per-org rate override (lift) to avoid customer outage while we mitigate root cause. suggest 400 r/s for 30m and watch.

alex (acct-eng): on the line with ZenBridge support contact, they confirm business impact and approve emergency lift. they prefer short window then rollback.

support (customer-ops): customer reports checkout failures and timeouts, high business impact. please proceed if safe. :warning:

dmitri (runtime): plan:
- apply override via internal RL API (per-org)
- monitor 429, error budget, and token cost
- add temporary alert for elevated latency
- schedule automatic rollback at +1800s unless escalated

Command I'll run (internal only):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/rate_override" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"org_id":"zbridge-42","override_qps":400,"ttl_seconds":1800,"reason":"emergency-lift-zenbridge-1768884321","author":"maria-oncall"}'
```

maria (oncall): executing the override now. will post response.

maria (oncall): API response: `{ "status": "ok", "override_id": "ov-1768884321-zenbridge", "applied_qps": 400 }`

monitoring-bot: override applied (ov-1768884321-zenbridge). Observed RL throttle for org=zenbridge decreased from ~92% -> ~18% within 40s. 429 rate trending down. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/zenbridge/rl

alex (acct-eng): customer notified: "we've applied a temporary lift and are monitoring. will rollback in ~30 minutes or earlier if stable." They acknowledged, thanks. :pray:

support (customer-ops): customer confirms errors subsided on their end. continuing to validate.

dmitri (runtime): monitoring for regressions. added ephemeral alert for error_rate>3% for the org. also enabling request sampling for 5m for deeper traces.

kevin (sre-lead): good mitigation. create incident ticket (INC-1768884321) for follow-up/PM. include cost impact estimate and ask product about replay protection.

maria (oncall): putting a note to roll back at +1800s unless someone requests extension. will update thread when rollback happens.

monitoring-bot: 10m update — 429s down to baseline, p95 latency improving. no new anomalies.

dmitri (runtime): leaving automated rollback scheduled. I'll also add a short-lived routing rule to reduce peak fanout from backend during the window.

kevin (sre-lead): postmortem owners: dmitri (runtime) + alex (acct-eng). action items: 1) confirm origin of replay/burst 2) implement per-org replay protection or dampening 3) document emergency-override playbook.

maria (oncall): closing the active pager for now, monitoring for 45m. will file follow-up notes in INC-1768884321. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
